digest.component_or_area: CLI help generation and route discovery
propositions: Twenty-one visible pure-intercept routes are absent from overview help and fail under `rebar help <command>` discovery despite having committed help artifacts
Identity child parsers disable their own help actions, causing `rebar identity create --help` to reach top-level usage and exit with error
The help-backed predicate must be exactly `not route.hidden and not route.retired` across all help discovery sites to provide consistent route visibility
Four intercept route parser factories lack nonblank descriptions needed to populate overview help for reconcile, enrich, identity, and certs commands
Usage normalization helpers must be moved and conditionally applied to intercept routes to preserve explicit multiline trusted-env usage while generating help artifacts
Top-level help must pre-scan every live visible route and enable child parser help for identity subcommands to return matching committed artifact bytes
